hints.title: Prefix Bitwise Array
hints.text: Precompute prefix cumulative bitwise exclusive or values to evaluate subarray ranges in constant time.

hints.title: Partition State DP
hints.text: Define dynamic programming state dp[i][p] as the minimum maximum subarray value partitioning the first i elements into p segments.

hints.title: Segment Boundary Iteration
hints.text: Iterate through previous partition boundaries j and minimize the maximum between dp[j][p - 1] and the range value.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Dynamic programming partitioning table with constant time prefix range queries.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute-force testing of all combinations of k - 1 partition splits is combinatorial.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: DP table of size N x K caches optimal sub-partition costs.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Formulate DP state minimizing the maximum subarray range XOR.
